review_scope: Independent manual review of final Document, Artifact prompt and manifest against explicit typed role plus supplied source observations. This is not actual-media perception or generated-video quality verification.

cases.requirement: Reference source identifies the generated subject; the showroom must not be copied merely from a subject-only role.
cases.reason: Final subject identity and carbon-fibre attribute are explicitly attributed to visual asset-1 identity; final prose keeps the same sports car moving forward. Source showroom is absent from target prose/claims; the featureless dark setting and generated engine/headlight details are creative. Manifest binds the picture to the one retained subject, with no dialogue.

checks.reason: Identity/provenance and written target are verified; exact pixel likeness is downstream and not evaluated.

cases.requirement: Reference source supplies the showroom environment; source car identity is not independently licensed as a subject reference.
cases.reason: Only the empty showroom floor becomes an observed environment subject attributed to asset-1/scene. Final car is generic caller car with no imported black sports-car or carbon-fibre identity; source environment remains in all three shots. Final manifest contains only the environment picture attribution; no speech.

checks.reason: Exact showroom layout and target rendering cannot be evaluated from the supplied summary card.

cases.requirement: Reference source supplies visual presentation; source car identity and showroom location are not independently licensed by the style role.
cases.reason: The final subject is caller car id=car with no source identity attribution; invented dark polished appearance and empty dark space are creative claims. Reference retains only visual style weak_reference, and the published prompt does not use the showroom or carbon fibre identity. No dialogue/speakers are published.

checks.reason: The supplied card gives Live-action, cinematic; exact style resemblance to pixels cannot be judged without rendering.

cases.requirement: Video supplies temporal/motion/composition guidance without independently importing source identity, scenery, or its audio track.
cases.reason: The source video is weak_reference for camera/cut structure only; the final low dark sedan and undefined dark setting are creative, with no source identity attribution or tunnel imported. Manifest binds visual asset-1 only and no audio track or speech.

checks.reason: The three-frame supplied card does not establish actual camera trajectory/cut timing, so exact temporal resemblance remains not_evaluable.

cases.requirement: Image supplies shot/composition guidance without independently importing subject identity, scenery, or speech.
cases.reason: Reference explicitly supplies viewpoint, placement and shot order across two target shots and uses weak_reference. The target is the caller generic car; shot prose adds dark space/headlights creatively, without carbon fibre sports-car or showroom identity. No speech is emitted.

checks.reason: The supplied card composition is unknown; exact composition resemblance cannot be evaluated from this fixture.

cases.requirement: First-frame source must be bound as an exact starting anchor at zero; its pose/framing may be retained through that license.
cases.reason: Mode i2va, first_frame role/socket, anchor_ms=0 and fully_preserved full supplied frame. Both prose and first visual event retain whole black sports car/showroom image at opening, then animate the caller forward motion. No partial panel extraction or added speech.

checks.reason: The manifest/prose anchor contract is verified; pixel-exact image preservation is downstream generation behavior not exercised here.

cases.requirement: Last-frame source must be bound as an exact ending anchor at the generated end; its pose/framing may be retained through that license.
cases.reason: Mode l2va, last_frame role/socket, anchor_ms=5000 at target end and fully_preserved whole source image. Closing prose explicitly settles into supplied complete final-frame position/layout; showroom/car are authorized by full-frame role. No speech.

checks.reason: The manifest/prose end anchor contract is verified; pixel-exact image preservation is downstream generation behavior not exercised here.

cases.requirement: Source video is the explicitly edited base; source visual continuity may be retained, but source audio is not automatically copied.
cases.reason: Final identity and tunnel are sourced from visual asset-1 under edit_source, fully_preserved; prompt declares edited version of Video1 and car continues forward through the tunnel. Source is exclusively visual in manifest; engine/tire/tunnel sounds are expressly new creative sound detail, with no dialogue.

checks.reason: Only three sampled frames were supplied; exact preservation of unseen source motion/audio is not evaluable.

cases.requirement: Source video is the continuation base; continuation must follow source motion/scene rather than reinterpret the clip as mere style.
cases.reason: Final subject and reference explicitly retain visual asset-1 as continuation_source/partially_preserved, not style. Same car/tunnel continue, including observed left-to-right travel in the middle shot, then move into light as requested. No audio-source binding or dialogue. Published retention acknowledges unseen intervals are not established.

checks.reason: The supplied three-frame partial card has no exact terminal frame/state/timing, so frame-exact continuation and new tunnel details cannot be verified as observations. They are target elaboration, not added observed claims.

cases.requirement: Audio supplies only voice character, not transcript or new dialogue; a speech-free car request must not invent speech solely to use the asset.
cases.reason: Audio asset-1 remains voice/reference property metadata with linked dormant speaker voice-asset-1. There is no Dialogue, spoken/sung event or performing (SN) label; manifest.speakers is empty. Newly generated engine rumble is target soundscape rather than copying source signal or manufacturing words to activate the voice.

checks.reason: The supplied card is engine-rumble characterisation and no vocal performance is requested, so active voice likeness is not evaluable; the dormant metadata is legitimate.

cases.requirement: Audio is the declared background track reference; it must not become dialogue, voice character or visual identity.
cases.reason: Manifest and final reference bind asset-1 audio as music with partially_copy. Prompt declares audio reuse and soundscape/music explicitly reuse the original low-engine recording under new audio. No transcript, voice identity or dialogue is created; visual car/setting are creative.

checks.reason: The supplied signal is described as a three-second rumble; actual five-second mix, extension and waveform continuity are downstream and not evaluable from the card.

cases.requirement: Audio supplies music-style characteristics; no permission to copy exact source audio or invent dialogue follows.
cases.reason: Reference and manifest use music_style/reference. Published retention and final music specify a newly generated low pulsing score without copying or reusing source signal. Generic car visuals remain separate and no dialogue or speakers are emitted.

checks.reason: The card has only engine-rumble characterisation rather than actual musical instrumentation/tempo evidence; acoustic stylistic fidelity is not evaluable.

cases.requirement: Audio supplies timing/rhythm guidance; no permission to copy exact source audio or invent dialogue follows.
cases.reason: Final reference and manifest bind audio asset-1 as beat_reference/reference across both shots. Retention/prompt define rhythm-guided cuts/action with no source signal copy; target has two shots and timed headlight/forward actions. No speech, performer or copied music is introduced.

checks.reason: The rumble characterisation contains no measured beat map, so actual beat alignment cannot be independently evaluated; only the requested timing contract is established.

cases.requirement: Audio supplies sound-effect reference; no permission to reinterpret it as dialogue or musical identity follows.
cases.reason: Audio reference is sfx with reference retention, not signal-copy. Prompt and soundscape explicitly generate a new engine rumble using texture only; manifest binds audio asset-1. Generic caller car remains separate, and no dialogue/speakers/music are introduced.

checks.reason: Actual waveform/texture likeness cannot be assessed from the supplied characterisation card alone.

cases.requirement: Incoming driver in red must be added using asset-1 while the edited base asset-2 retains its own driver, car and tunnel; placement must not silently replace an existing identity.
cases.reason: Incoming red-jacket driver is subject-1 from picture asset-1/placed_subject, while grey-overall original driver and black carbon-fibre car remain distinct subjects from base visual asset-2/edit_source. Final prose depicts original driver crossing left-to-right and incoming driver at wheel in the same retained tunnel/sodium-light scene. No photo showroom/background or new speech is imported. Placement adds identity and correctly has no inherited replacement-motion obligation.

checks.reason: The supplied partial video card does not establish exact actor staging/trajectory over unseen source intervals; this verifies the target graph and written edit, not generated pixels.

cases.requirement: Incoming driver in red must replace the explicitly targeted original driver, retaining the base car/tunnel and inherited motion; the replacement must not duplicate or preserve the replaced driver identity.
cases.reason: Incoming red-jacket identity from picture asset-1 replaces base driver subject-2. Original driver has attribute_transfer/taken_over_by=subject-1 with grey-overall appearance removed; final action depicts only incoming driver walking inherited left-to-right path. Explicit motion obligation binds original driver and base asset-2 observation. Base black carbon-fibre car/tunnel/sodium lighting remain; incoming photo background/pose and source audio are not copied. No dialogue.

checks.reason: The source card is partial; exact continuous motion/timing and pixel identity retention remain downstream and cannot be evaluated beyond recorded left-to-right motion and typed provenance.

scope_limit: All sixteen role contracts passed against typed supplied cards; per-check actual-media/render fidelity remains not_evaluable. This does not certify generated video, audio rendering, or the entire live suite.
